interface.longDescription:
Find Spanish grant calls and separate potentially relevant funding from closed calls, direct awards and unsupported eligibility claims.

Includes a focused assistant workflow, official-source references, review examples and a Python 3.11+ read-only adapter. In ChatGPT, uses available native browsing/file tools; in Claude Code or Codex, the bundled scripts can retrieve official data directly when networking is permitted. No separate account, API key or publisher-hosted server is required for this skills release.

No application submission, automatic eligibility guarantee, bank access, paid grant database, universal regional coverage claim or background alerts.

Independent software by Sami Halawa. Not affiliated with Spanish public authorities.
